_comment: M1 (audit): integration test of the wiki<->daily-brief seam. Seeds a vault with an overdue todo, a due-today todo, a today event, and a today birthday, then runs bin/daily-brief --date 2026-05-20 and asserts all four sections render. Guards against format drift between wiki's stdout and daily-brief's parsers (a silent drift would make the brief report 'clean slate' while reminders exist). The `bin` field tells the runner to execute bin/daily-brief for the cmd; setup steps still run wiki.
